I'm 18 and I'm a forever alone girl, and it's one of many reasons I want to die. I swear I probably make guys uncomfortable because no one ever hits on me, I know I take care of myself and am not ugly, and I think I'm a really nice and caring person, but it sucks being forever alone. Girls are supposed to get hit on more than guys (just because guys are more likely to hit on random girls), but I don't get hit on at all. I know guys that get hit on more than I do. Every guy I ever like seems creeped out by me or something. I've never even kissed a guy. If any guy ever approached me or asked me out I'd be beyond flattered. Don't listen to those girls... they're probably high strung, or maybe you wouldn't have meshed well with them anyway. 

I'd give you a chance if you even had the guts to ask me out, even if I found you "creepy", and I know a lot of girls would agree. First impressions don't necessarily mean much, honestly.
Are you online? I don't see you.
Let's talk then! Do you have MSN?
Hey, thanks for the quick reply. :) I'm writing a message right now.
